headline: Wall Street czeka na debiut potęgi AI. Fala optymizmu przetacza się przez giełdę
summary: Investors await the first trading of Anthropic on Nasdaq after a record offering lifted the technology sector. The Nasdaq is up nearly 2%, with chipmakers and cloud providers gaining several percent.
why: Anthropic is an AI company that develops the Claude models. Its listing is a key test of investor appetite for AI firms and affects valuations across chip and cloud stocks.
why_moved: A record offering from the AI developer lifted the whole technology sector ahead of its first trading session on Nasdaq. Optimism about AI demand spread to chip and cloud suppliers.
